content.title: Can I fly a drone in Arvada parks?
content.summary: The City of Arvada does not currently have a local ordinance regulating drone use. faqs.q: Can I fly a drone in Arvada parks?
faqs.a: The City of Arvada does not currently have a local ordinance regulating drone use. However, community members must still follow all applicable state and federal regulations when flying drones in Arvada parks or any public space. Please visit the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) website for more information.
